input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants Garman no audit, inspection or verification rights over Sparkling. Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verify", "premises", "monitor" and "access" return nothing binding Sparkling: the restrictions on use (§3, p0031-p0039) impose obligations but no right of examination; the fees clause (§11, p0084) contains no records or verification right; General Matters (§20 and p0141-p0149) covers only notices, waiver, assignment, force majeure, severability, governing law and entire agreement; and the only "access" references are Sparkling's telephone support access (p0073) and mutual confidentiality (p0095). There is also no right of remote or direct access to Sparkling systems. Because no audit right binds us, the exposure this rule addresses does not arise and the position is better than the preferred one (frequency, notice, cost and system-access limits are unnecessary where there is no audit right at all). No redline: we would not volunteer an audit right against ourselves.
